about: Word check of code points no table writes, re-analysed this session from the first session's documents fam/extra-ban.docx (SHREE-BAN-0550) and fam/extra-guj7.docx (SHREE-GUJ7-0750), their Word PDFs and per-paragraph EMFs (paragraph order in both: U+017E, U+009E, U+017D, U+20AC, U+0081 / U+017E, U+20AC, U+0081).

SHREE-BAN-0550.U+017E: PDF: Cambria code 101; EMF: Cambria U+017E, GDI playback ink 4338 px -> Word falls back to Cambria and draws the real z-caron
SHREE-BAN-0550.U+017D: PDF: Cambria; EMF: Cambria U+017D, ink 6103 px -> Cambria
SHREE-BAN-0550.U+20AC: PDF: TimesNewRomanPSMT code BC; EMF: Times New Roman U+20AC, ink 4551 px -> Times New Roman draws the euro
SHREE-BAN-0550.U+009E: PDF: SHREE-BAN-0550 code 9E (F1 vs the font's glyph 0.28: PDF viewers draw .notdef, WinAnsi 9E = zcaron); EMF: SHREE-BAN-0550 U+009E, GDI playback ink 0 -> advance, nothing drawn
SHREE-BAN-0550.U+0081: PDF: SHREE-BAN-0550 code 81 (bullet glyph in viewers); EMF: SHREE-BAN-0550 U+0081, ink 0 -> nothing drawn

SHREE-GUJ7-0750.U+0081: EMF: SHREE-GUJ7-0750 U+0081, ink 0 -> nothing drawn
